title: Mike Macdonald says 'Sam's our quarterback' amid chatter that Drew Lock should start for Seahawks over Darnold

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Mike Macdonald says 'Sam's our quarterback' amid chatter that Drew Lock should start for Seahawks over Darnold
sources.description: The Seahawks are now 4-0 this season with Lock, who's played objectively better than Sam Darnold in place of the injured Seattle starter in four appearances.
